changelog:
Initial release with unified multi-modal API and web search features.

- Enables web search, news lookup, and current content retrieval.
- Access to 50+ models: image, video, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, document parsing, email, and SMS.
- One API key for all supported providers (OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, ElevenLabs, Replicate, Minimax, and more).
- Smart routing for selecting optimal models per task.
- Example Bash commands and parameters for all supported modalities.
summary: Search the web for information, find current content, and look up news articles. And also 50+ models for image generation, video generation, text-to-speech,...
